last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 13
last_episode_to_air.overview: At Hanımeli, the team fends off the police raid, successfully completing their final mission. Emir saves Çido and Efe from Boris’s deadly attack, but when Çido uncovers that the hidden enemy Boris deployed is Aydan’s brother, Eralp, all the balances shift dramatically. At the hotel, the danger intensifies as Eralp takes the team hostage and seizes control. A shocking confrontation erupts between Aydan and her brother. Under Aydan’s leadership, Emir, Efe, and Eralp unite on a single front against Boris. Emir sacrifices his own freedom to save his loved ones and start anew. Aydan takes command of the team, growing their operations and bringing her own projects to life. A new era begins for ÇAF, both in love and work.

name: Gilded Lies
overview: While working as a hairdresser in an Istanbul suburb, Aydan finds herself the owner of a luxury beauty salon. Her shadowy new boss is Emir, a mysterious businessman about whom no one knows anything. As Aydan struggles to adapt to Emir's world, she's also forced to contend with the troubles caused by her reluctant partner, Çiğdem, a vagrant who grew up in an orphanage. Efe, the reckless police officer who follows Emir, inevitably crosses paths with Çiğdem and the hairdresser. Amidst all this chaos, Aydan seeks solace in her dear friend, manicurist Fiko, while her ex-husband, talented hairdresser Tarık, who can't stomach Aydan's new world of luxury, finds himself facing a new problem every day.
